snippet.title: WILD Tactics | Indie Fan Fest | Feb 2026
snippet.description: Wild Tactics is a turn-based strategy RPG where you lead a squad of wild animal heroes (and anti-heroes!), including everything from ex-soldiers to reformed ex-criminals, to save a city on the brink of ruin. Build your base, recruit new characters, and use each hero's unique abilities to master choice-driven tactical missions in this XCOM-like neon-noir adventure. Your final goal: forge and lead this rebellious team into a powerful force capable of restoring order and averting disaster in the chaotic city of the Wilderness.
